leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a functional component that uses the useCallback hook to memoize a function
Apply useCallback to prevent unnecessary re-renders in child components
Construct a callback function with dependencies to maintain stable references
Configure event handlers with useCallback to optimize performance
Update component state using callback functions wrapped in useCallback
Bind memoized callbacks to interactive elements like buttons
Integrate useCallback with useEffect to manage side effects efficiently
